```{r Step 2: Census QWI Pull, include=TRUE}
my_key <- Sys.getenv("census_api_key")

#Function to pull a single state-quarter combination
get_qwi_county <- function(state_fips,
                           time_period,
                           variable) {
  
  req <- request("https://api.census.gov/data/timeseries/qwi/sa") |>
    req_url_query(
      get = variable,
      `for` = "county:*",
      `in` = paste0("state:", state_fips),
      time = time_period,
      sex = "0",
      agegrp = "A00",
      industry = "00",
      key = my_key
    )
  
  resp <- tryCatch(
    req |> req_perform(),
    error = function(e) return(NULL)
  )
  
  if (is.null(resp)) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  txt <- tryCatch(
    resp_body_string(resp),
    error = function(e) return("")
  )
  
  if (nchar(txt) == 0 || grepl("<html", txt)) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  parsed <- tryCatch(
    jsonlite::fromJSON(txt),
    error = function(e) return(NULL)
  )
  
  if (is.null(parsed) || length(parsed) < 2) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  df <- as_tibble(parsed[-1, , drop = FALSE])
  names(df) <- parsed[1, ]
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      state = sprintf("%02d", as.integer(state)),
      county = sprintf("%03d", as.integer(county)),
      county_fips = paste0(state, county)
    )
  
}

#Function to pull all counties and quarters for a single variable
pull_all_qwi <- function(variable) {
  
  grid <- expand.grid(
    state = sprintf("%02d", 1:56),
    time = sprintf(
      "%d-Q%d",
      rep(2006:2025, each = 4),
      1:4
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  results <- vector("list", nrow(grid))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
    
    if (i %% 100 == 0) {
      message(i, " of ", nrow(grid), " requests completed")
    }
    
    results[[i]] <- tryCatch(
      get_qwi_county(
        state_fips = grid$state[i],
        time_period = grid$time[i],
        variable = variable
      ),
      error = function(e) tibble()
    )
    
  }
  
  bind_rows(results)
  
}

#Real Pulls of Employment Variables
turnover <- pull_all_qwi("TurnOvrS")
employment <- pull_all_qwi("Emp")
earnings <- pull_all_qwi("EarnS")
separations <- pull_all_qwi("Sep")
job_creation <- pull_all_qwi("FrmJbC")
hires <- pull_all_qwi("HirA")
job_losses <- pull_all_qwi("FrmJbLs")


#Saving Each Pull as a Dataset
saveRDS(turnover, "qwi_turnover.rds")
saveRDS(employment, "qwi_employment.rds")
saveRDS(earnings, "qwi_earnings.rds")
saveRDS(separations, "qwi_separations.rds")
saveRDS(job_creation, "qwi_job_creation.rds")
saveRDS(hires, "qwi_hires.rds")
saveRDS(job_losses, "qwi_job_losses.rds")


#Merge Into a Single Panel Dataset
qwi_panel <- turnover %>%
  left_join(
    employment %>%
      select(county_fips, time, Emp),
    by = c("county_fips", "time")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    earnings %>%
      select(county_fips, time, EarnS),
    by = c("county_fips", "time")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    separations %>%
      select(county_fips, time, Sep),
    by = c("county_fips", "time")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    job_creation %>%
      select(county_fips, time, FrmJbC),
    by = c("county_fips", "time")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hires %>%
      select(county_fips, time, HirA),
    by = c("county_fips", "time")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    job_losses %>%
      select(county_fips, time, FrmJbLs),
    by = c("county_fips", "time")
  )

#Add County Names to Panel
county_lookup <- fips_codes %>%
  distinct(
    state_code,
    county_code,
    county,
    state
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    county_fips = paste0(state_code, county_code)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    county_name = county,
    state_name = state
  ) %>%
  select(
    county_fips,
    county_name,
    state_name
  )

qwi_panel <- qwi_panel %>%
  left_join(
    county_lookup,
    by = "county_fips"
  )



#Create Rolling Averages for Churn Data

qwi_panel <- qwi_panel %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(substr(time, 1, 4)),
    quarter = as.integer(substr(time, 7, 7)),
    quarter_index = year * 4 + quarter
  ) %>%
  arrange(county_fips, quarter_index)


qwi_panel <- qwi_panel %>%
  mutate(
    HirA = as.numeric(HirA),
    Sep = as.numeric(Sep),
    churn_raw = HirA + Sep
  )

qwi_panel <- qwi_panel %>%
  arrange(county_fips, time) %>%
  group_by(county_fips) %>%
  mutate(
    churn_4q = slide_dbl(
      churn_raw,
      mean,
      .before = 3,
      .complete = TRUE,
      .na_rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


qwi_panel <- qwi_panel %>%
  mutate(
    TurnOvrS = as.numeric(TurnOvrS)
  ) %>%
  arrange(county_fips, time) %>%
  group_by(county_fips) %>%
  mutate(
    turnover_churn = slide_dbl(
      TurnOvrS,
      mean,
      .before = 3,
      .complete = TRUE,
      .na_rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(qwi_panel, here("01_tidydata", "QuarterlyWorkforceIndicators0625.csv"))
```

```{r Step 4: Merging CES Data to QWI and Tausanovitch and Warshaw Data, include=TRUE}
#Cleaning and Merging Workforce Data 
qwi_panel <- qwi_panel %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(substr(time, 1, 4))
  )

qwi_yearly <- qwi_panel %>%
  group_by(county_fips, year) %>%
  summarize(
    churn_4q = mean(churn_4q, na.rm = TRUE),
    churn_raw = mean(churn_raw, na.rm = TRUE),

    TurnOvrS = mean(TurnOvrS, na.rm = TRUE),
    Emp = mean(Emp, na.rm = TRUE),
    EarnS = mean(EarnS, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sep = mean(Sep, na.rm = TRUE),
    FrmJbC = mean(FrmJbC, na.rm = TRUE),
    FrmJbLs = mean(FrmJbLs, na.rm = TRUE),
    HirA = mean(HirA, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

qwi_yearly %>%
  count(year)

analysis_data <- cespanel %>%
  left_join(
    qwi_yearly,
    by = c( "county_fips", "year"
    )
  )


#Tausanovitch and Warshaw Data 
county_ideology_1 <- county_ideology_1 %>%
  mutate(
    county_fips = str_pad(
      as.character(county_fips),
      width = 5,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    )
  )

county_ideology_1 <- county_ideology_1 %>%
  mutate(
    start_year = as.integer(str_extract(survey_period, "^\\d{4}")),
    end_year = as.integer(str_extract(survey_period, "\\d{4}$"))
  )

county_ideology_yearly <- county_ideology_1 %>%
  mutate(
    start_year = as.integer(str_extract(survey_period, "^\\d{4}")),
    end_year = as.integer(str_extract(survey_period, "\\d{4}$"))
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(year = list(start_year:end_year)) %>%
  unnest(year) %>%
  ungroup()

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  left_join(
    county_ideology_yearly,
    by = c( "county_fips", "year")
  )
```
